# opnsense_nginx_syslog_target (Resource)

nginx syslog targets (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Other ▸ Syslog Target**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description.
- `host` (String) Host.

### Optional

- `facility` (String) Facility. One of `kern`, `user`, `mail`, `daemon`, `auth`, `intern`, `lpr`, `news`, `uucp`, `clock`, `authpriv`, `ftp`, `ntp`, `audit`, `alert`, `cron`, `local0`, `local1`, `local2`, `local3`, `local4`, `local5`, `local6`, `local7`. Defaults to `local7`.
- `nohostname` (Boolean) No Hostname. Defaults to `false`.
- `port` (Number) Port. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `severity` (String) Severity. One of `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `error`, `crit`, `alert`, `emerg`. Defaults to `error`.
- `tag` (String) Tag. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx syslog target.
